items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: Sa'i took my place... He brings my drums back where I left over there for him to play on.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Sa'i we call him, huh?

Yeah, Sa'i. That's right. Married my cousin. Well, he took my place and three weeks afterwards, he comes to my house. He brings my drums back where I left over there for him to play on. He told me like, yes, he said, Cha'i. Say, how you do the... How you do the whole up the band like you did? I said, why? What's wrong with it? He said, didn't you like it? He said, yeah, but... Oh, man, I can't make that. He said, he played 22 quarters of high society and then told me to go out hot. So I told him I just couldn't…
Well, just one second. Let me try one other...

items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: When I left in 1930, Joshua Frazier took my place.

ctx.x: I don't believe this is catching it loud enough.
I don't know. It's disgusting. When I left... Yeah, go ahead. When I left in 1930, Joshua Frazier took my place.
Oh, yeah. Sa'i we call him, huh?
